item.text: [{"task_id":"623ea044","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['background'][0]))","    slope = params['slope'][0]","    height, width = grid.shape","    out = np.full(grid.shape, background, dtype=int)","    seeds = np.argwhere(grid != background)","    for seed in seeds:","        row, col = seed","        color = int(grid[row, col])","        for r in range(height):","            for c in range(width):","                if np.abs(r - row) == slope * np.abs(c - col):","                    out[r, c] = color","    return out"],"shapes":{"background":[1],"slope":[1]},"params":{"background":[0],"slope":[1]},"rationale":"Extend the seed's color along both diagonals through its position to the grid boundaries. The background and diagonal slope are tensor-controlled; zeroed tensors produce a horizontal line instead of the required X."}]
